title: एकाशीत्यधिकशततमोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 181 · Arjuna and Bhima defeat Karna and Shalya

summary.en: Arjuna fights Karna, who withdraws, unwilling to contend with Brahmin power; Bhima throws Shalya. Krishna calms the kings, saying the bride was won fairly, and the brothers return at evening to the potter's house with Draupadi.
summary.kn: ಅರ್ಜುನನು ಕರ್ಣನೊಂದಿಗೆ ಹೋರಾಡುತ್ತಾನೆ, ಬ್ರಾಹ್ಮಣತೇಜಸ್ಸಿನೊಂದಿಗೆ ಹೋರಾಡಲು ಇಷ್ಟಪಡದೆ ಕರ್ಣನು ಹಿಂದೆ ಸರಿಯುತ್ತಾನೆ; ಭೀಮನು ಶಲ್ಯನನ್ನು ನೆಲಕ್ಕುರುಳಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಕನ್ಯೆ ನ್ಯಾಯವಾಗಿ ಗೆಲ್ಲಲ್ಪಟ್ಟಳು ಎಂದು ಶ್ರೀಕೃಷ್ಣನು ರಾಜರನ್ನು ಶಾಂತಗೊಳಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ; ಸಂಜೆ ಸಹೋದರರು ದ್ರೌಪದಿಯೊಂದಿಗೆ ಕುಂಬಾರನ ಮನೆಗೆ ಮರಳುತ್ತಾರೆ.
summary.hi: अर्जुन कर्ण से लड़ते हैं, जो ब्राह्मण-तेज से टकराना न चाहकर पीछे हट जाते हैं; भीम शल्य को पटक देते हैं। श्रीकृष्ण यह कहकर राजाओं को शान्त करते हैं कि कन्या न्याय से जीती गई है, और सन्ध्या को भाई द्रौपदी के साथ कुम्हार के घर लौटते हैं।
summary.te: అర్జునుడు కర్ణునితో పోరాడతాడు, బ్రాహ్మణ తేజస్సుతో తలపడడానికి ఇష్టపడక కర్ణుడు వెనుదిరుగుతాడు; భీముడు శల్యుని నేలకేస్తాడు. కన్య న్యాయంగా గెలవబడిందని శ్రీకృష్ణుడు రాజులను శాంతపరుస్తాడు; సాయంత్రం సోదరులు ద్రౌపదితో కుమ్మరి ఇంటికి తిరిగివస్తారు.
summary.ta: அர்ஜுனன் கர்ணனுடன் போரிட, அந்தண ஆற்றலுடன் மோத விரும்பாத கர்ணன் பின்வாங்குகிறான்; பீமன் ஶல்யனைக் கீழே வீழ்த்துகிறான். மணமகள் நேர்மையாக வெல்லப்பட்டாள் என்று ஸ்ரீகிருஷ்ணர் மன்னர்களை அமைதிப்படுத்த, மாலையில் சகோதரர்கள் திரௌபதியுடன் குயவர் வீட்டுக்குத் திரும்புகிறார்கள்.
summary.ml: കർണ്ണനോട് അർജുനൻ പോരാടുന്നു; ബ്രാഹ്മണശക്തിയോട് മത്സരിക്കാൻ തയ്യാറല്ലാത്ത അദ്ദേഹം പിന്മാറുന്നു; ഭീമൻ ശല്യരെ വീഴ്ത്തുന്നു. വധു ന്യായമായി നേടപ്പെട്ടതാണെന്ന് പറഞ്ഞ് കൃഷ്ണൻ രാജാക്കന്മാരെ ശാന്തരാക്കുന്നു; വൈകുന്നേരം സഹോദരന്മാർ ദ്രൗപദിയോടൊപ്പം കുശവന്റെ വീട്ടിലേക്ക് മടങ്ങുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 1.181; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Thu Aug 22 2026

verses.text: वैशंपायन उवाच

meaning.en: Vaishampayana said:

verses.text:
अजिनानि विधुन्वन्तः करकांश्च द्विजर्षभाः ।
ऊचुस्तं भीर्न कर्तव्या वयं योत्स्यामहे परान् ॥

meaning.en: The foremost Brahmins, shaking their deerskins and water-pots, said to him, 'Do not be afraid; we will fight the enemy.'

verses.text:
तानेवं वदतो विप्रानर्जुनः प्रहसन्निव ।
उवाच प्रेक्षका भूत्वा यूयं तिष्ठत पार्श्वतः ॥

meaning.en: To those Brahmins speaking so, Arjuna said, as if laughing: Stand aside and be spectators.

verses.text:
अहमेनानजिह्माग्रैः शतशो विकिरञ्शरैः ।
वारयिष्यामि संक्रुद्धान्मन्त्रैराशीविषानिव ॥

meaning.en: I will scatter hundreds of straight-tipped arrows and hold off these angry kings, as mantras hold off venomous snakes.

verses.text:
इति तद्धनुरादाय शुल्कावाप्तं महारथः ।
भ्रात्रा भीमेन सहितस्तस्थौ गिरिरिवाचलः ॥

meaning.en: So saying, the great chariot-warrior took the bow he had won as the prize and stood like an unmoving mountain with his brother Bhima.

verses.text:
ततः कर्णमुखान्क्रुद्धान्क्षत्रियांस्तान्रुषोत्थितान् ।
संपेततुरभीतौ तौ गजौ प्रतिगजानिव ॥

meaning.en: Then the two, unafraid, fell upon those Kshatriyas, led by Karna and risen in anger, like elephants on rival elephants.

verses.text:
ऊचुश्च वाचः परुषास्ते राजानो जिघांसवः ।
आहवे हि द्विजस्यापि वधो दृष्टो युयुत्सतः ॥

meaning.en: Those kings, wanting to kill, said harsh words: 'In battle even a Brahmin who fights may be killed.'

verses.text:
ततो वैकर्तनः कर्णो जगामार्जुनमोजसा ।
युद्धार्थी वाशिताहेतोर्गजः प्रतिगजं यथा ॥

meaning.en: Then Karna, son of Vikartana, rushed with force at Arjuna wanting to fight, like an elephant at a rival over a cow-elephant.

verses.text:
भीमसेनं ययौ शल्यो मद्राणामीश्वरो बली ।
दुर्योधनादयस्त्वन्ये ब्राह्मणैः सह संगताः ।
मृदुपूर्वमयत्नेन प्रत्ययुध्यंस्तदाहवे ॥

meaning.en: Shalya, mighty king of the Madras, went against Bhima. Duryodhana and the others, joining the Brahmins, fought gently at first and without effort in that battle.

verses.text:
ततोऽर्जुनः प्रत्यविध्यदापतन्तं त्रिभिः शरैः ।
कर्णं वैकर्तनं धीमान्विकृष्य बलवद्धनुः ॥

meaning.en: Then wise Arjuna drew his strong bow and struck Karna, son of Vikartana, as he came on, with three arrows.

verses.text:
तेषां शराणां वेगेन शितानां तिग्मतेजसाम् ।
विमुह्यमानो राधेयो यत्नात्तमनुधावति ॥

meaning.en: Dazed by the speed of those sharp, fierce arrows, Radha's son Karna pursued him with effort.

verses.text:
तावुभावप्यनिर्देश्यौ लाघवाज्जयतां वरौ ।
अयुध्येतां सुसंरब्धावन्योन्यविजयैषिणौ ॥

meaning.en: Both were beyond description, best of conquerors in dexterity; they fought furiously, each seeking victory over the other.

verses.text:
कृते प्रतिकृतं पश्य पश्य बाहुबलं च मे ।
इति शूरार्थवचनैराभाषेतां परस्परम् ॥

meaning.en: 'See a return for what you did! See the strength of my arms!' they said to each other in boasting, heroic words.

verses.text:
ततोऽर्जुनस्य भुजयोर्वीर्यमप्रतिमं भुवि ।
ज्ञात्वा वैकर्तनः कर्णः संरब्धः समयोधयत् ॥

meaning.en: Then Karna, son of Vikartana, realising the unmatched strength of Arjuna's arms, fought on with greater fury.

verses.text:
अर्जुनेन प्रयुक्तांस्तान्बाणान्वेगवतस्तदा ।
प्रतिहत्य ननादोच्चैः सैन्यास्तमभिपूजयन् ॥

meaning.en: He deflected the swift arrows shot by Arjuna and roared loudly, and the troops applauded him.

verses.text: कर्ण उवाच

meaning.en: Karna said:

verses.text:
तुष्यामि ते विप्रमुख्य भुजवीर्यस्य संयुगे ।
अविषादस्य चैवास्य शस्त्रास्त्रविनयस्य च ॥

meaning.en: I am pleased with you, best of Brahmins, with the strength of your arms in battle, your steadiness, and your discipline in weapons and missiles.

verses.text:
किं त्वं साक्षाद्धनुर्वेदो रामो वा विप्रसत्तम ।
अथ साक्षाद्धरिहयः साक्षाद्वा विष्णुरच्युतः ॥

meaning.en: Are you the very Science of the Bow itself, or Rama, best of Brahmins, or Indra himself, or Vishnu the unfallen?

verses.text:
आत्मप्रच्छादनार्थं वै बाहुवीर्यमुपाश्रितः ।
विप्ररूपं विधायेदं ततो मां प्रतियुध्यसे ॥

meaning.en: Relying on the strength of your arms and having taken a Brahmin's form to hide yourself, you fight me.

verses.text:
न हि मामाहवे क्रुद्धमन्यः साक्षाच्छचीपतेः ।
पुमान्योधयितुं शक्तः पाण्डवाद्वा किरीटिनः ॥

meaning.en: For no other man, other than Indra the husband of Shachi himself or the Pandava Arjuna, can fight me in battle when I am enraged.

verses.text: वैशंपायन उवाच

meaning.en: Vaishampayana said:

verses.text:
तमेवंवादिनं तत्र फल्गुनः प्रत्यभाषत ।
नास्मि कर्ण धनुर्वेदो नास्मि रामः प्रतापवान् ।
ब्राह्मणोऽस्मि युधां श्रेष्ठः सर्वशस्त्रभृतां वरः ॥

meaning.en: To him thus speaking, Arjuna replied: Karna, I am not the Science of the Bow, nor mighty Rama. I am a Brahmin, best of fighters and foremost of all who bear weapons.

verses.text:
ब्राह्मे पौरंदरे चास्त्रे निष्ठितो गुरुशासनात् ।
स्थितोऽस्म्यद्य रणे जेतुं त्वां वीराविचलो भव ॥

meaning.en: By my teacher's command I am accomplished in the Brahma weapon and the weapon of Indra. I stand here today to defeat you in battle, hero; be steady.

verses.text:
एवमुक्तस्तु राधेयो युद्धात्कर्णो न्यवर्तत ।
ब्राह्मं तेजस्तदाजय्यं मन्यमानो महारथः ॥

meaning.en: Thus addressed, Radha's son Karna withdrew from the fight, thinking the Brahmin's power invincible, that great chariot-warrior.

verses.text:
युद्धं तूपेयतुस्तत्र राजञ्शल्यवृकोदरौ ।
बलिनौ युगपन्मत्तौ स्पर्धया च बलेन च ॥

meaning.en: Meanwhile, king, Shalya and Vrikodara joined battle, both strong and both intoxicated with rivalry and strength.

verses.text:
अन्योन्यमाह्वयन्तौ तौ मत्ताविव महागजौ ।
मुष्टिभिर्जानुभिश्चैव निघ्नन्तावितरेतरम् ।
मुहूर्तं तौ तथान्योन्यं समरे पर्यकर्षताम् ॥

meaning.en: Challenging each other like two great rutting elephants, striking each other with fists and knees, they dragged one another about in the fight for a while.

verses.text:
ततो भीमः समुत्क्षिप्य बाहुभ्यां शल्यमाहवे ।
न्यवधीद्बलिनां श्रेष्ठो जहसुर्ब्राह्मणास्ततः ॥

meaning.en: Then Bhima, the best of the strong, lifted Shalya with his arms and threw him down in the contest, and the Brahmins laughed.

verses.text:
तत्राश्चर्यं भीमसेनश्चकार पुरुषर्षभः ।
यच्छल्यं पतितं भूमौ नाहनद्बलिनं बली ॥

meaning.en: Bhimasena, bull among men, did a wonderful thing there: though strong, he did not kill the strong Shalya when he lay fallen.

verses.text:
पातिते भीमसेनेन शल्ये कर्णे च शङ्किते ।
शङ्किताः सर्वराजानः परिवव्रुर्वृकोदरम् ॥

meaning.en: When Shalya had been thrown by Bhimasena and Karna had grown wary, all the kings, wary too, surrounded Vrikodara.

verses.text:
ऊचुश्च सहितास्तत्र साध्विमे ब्राह्मणर्षभाः ।
विज्ञायन्तां क्वजन्मानः क्वनिवासास्तथैव च ॥

meaning.en: They said together: These excellent Brahmins deserve praise. Let us find out where they were born and where they live.

verses.text:
को हि राधासुतं कर्णं शक्तो योधयितुं रणे ।
अन्यत्र रामाद्द्रोणाद्वा कृपाद्वापि शरद्वतः ॥

meaning.en: For who can fight Karna, son of Radha, in battle, except Rama, Drona or Kripa son of Sharadvat?

verses.text:
कृष्णाद्वा देवकीपुत्रात्फल्गुनाद्वा परंतपात् ।
को वा दुर्योधनं शक्तः प्रतियोधयितुं रणे ॥

meaning.en: Or Krishna, son of Devaki, or Arjuna, scorcher of foes? And who can fight Duryodhana in battle?

verses.text:
तथैव मद्रराजानं शल्यं बलवतां वरम् ।
बलदेवादृते वीरात्पाण्डवाद्वा वृकोदरात् ॥

meaning.en: Likewise who can fight Shalya, king of Madra and best of the strong, except the hero Baladeva or the Pandava Vrikodara?

verses.text:
क्रियतामवहारोऽस्माद्युद्धाद्ब्राह्मणसंयुतात् ।
अथैनानुपलभ्येह पुनर्योत्स्यामहे वयम् ॥

meaning.en: Let us withdraw from this battle with the Brahmins. When we have found out who they are, we can fight them again.

verses.text:
तत्कर्म भीमस्य समीक्ष्य कृष्णः
कुन्तीसुतौ तौ परिशङ्कमानः ।
निवारयामास महीपतींस्ता-
न्धर्मेण लब्धेत्यनुनीय सर्वान् ॥

meaning.en: Seeing Bhima's deed and suspecting that these two were the sons of Kunti, Krishna calmed all those kings and restrained them, saying that she had been won lawfully.

verses.text:
त एवं संनिवृत्तास्तु युद्धाद्युद्धविशारदाः ।
यथावासं ययुः सर्वे विस्मिता राजसत्तमाः ॥

meaning.en: So those kings, skilled in war, turned back from the fight, and all went to their lodgings astonished.

verses.text:
वृत्तो ब्रह्मोत्तरो रङ्गः पाञ्चाली ब्राह्मणैर्वृता ।
इति ब्रुवन्तः प्रययुर्ये तत्रासन्समागताः ॥

meaning.en: Saying 'The arena has been won by Brahmins, and the Panchala princess has been taken by Brahmins,' all who had gathered there went away.

verses.text:
ब्राह्मणैस्तु प्रतिच्छन्नौ रौरवाजिनवासिभिः ।
कृच्छ्रेण जग्मतुस्तत्र भीमसेनधनंजयौ ॥

meaning.en: Hidden by the Brahmins in ruru-skin garments, Bhimasena and Dhananjaya went on with difficulty.

verses.text:
विमुक्तौ जनसंबाधाच्छत्रुभिः परिविक्षतौ ।
कृष्णयानुगतौ तत्र नृवीरौ तौ विरेजतुः ॥

meaning.en: Freed from the crush of people and having been harassed by enemies, those two heroes among men, followed by Krishna, shone there.

verses.text:
तेषां माता बहुविधं विनाशं पर्यचिन्तयत् ।
अनागच्छत्सु पुत्रेषु भैक्षकालेऽतिगच्छति ॥

meaning.en: Their mother, as the time for alms-gathering passed and her sons did not come, thought of many kinds of ruin.

verses.text:
धार्तराष्ट्रैर्हता न स्युर्विज्ञाय कुरुपुंगवाः ।
मायान्वितैर्वा रक्षोभिः सुघोरैर्दृढवैरिभिः ॥

meaning.en: She thought: Could the bulls of the Kurus have been killed by the Dhritarashtra sons after recognising them, or by dreadful, deceitful rakshasas, firm enemies?

verses.text:
विपरीतं मतं जातं व्यासस्यापि महात्मनः ।
इत्येवं चिन्तयामास सुतस्नेहान्विता पृथा ॥

meaning.en: Or has even great-souled Vyasa's judgment turned out wrong? So Pritha, filled with love for her sons, thought.

verses.text:
महत्यथापराह्णे तु घनैः सूर्य इवावृतः ।
ब्राह्मणैः प्राविशत्तत्र जिष्णुर्ब्रह्मपुरस्कृतः ॥

meaning.en: Then late in the afternoon, like the sun covered by clouds, Arjuna entered there, surrounded by Brahmins and with the Brahmins before him.
